nodes.summary: Let $N$ and $r$ be natural numbers with $0 < N$, $r \le N$, $2r \le N$ and $6 \le N$. For a natural number $x$ write $x\#$ for the primorial of $x$, the product of all primes $p \le x$, and let $L = \lfloor \log_2 N \rfloor$. If $r! \cdot \lfloor N/3 \rfloor\# \cdot \prod_{m=2}^{L} \lfloor N^{1/m} \rfloor\# < (N + 1 - r)^r$, then the binomial coefficient $\binom{N}{r}$ has a prime factor $p > r$.
nodes.title: Erdős layer criterion, factorial form

nodes.summary: Let $N$ and $r$ be natural numbers with $4 \le r$, $2r \le N$ and $6 \le N$. For a natural number $x$ write $x\#$ for the primorial of $x$, the product of all primes $p \le x$, and let $L = \lfloor \log_2 N \rfloor$. If $r \cdot \lfloor N/3 \rfloor\# \cdot \prod_{m=2}^{L} \lfloor N^{1/m} \rfloor\# < 4^r$, then the binomial coefficient $\binom{N}{r}$ has a prime factor $p > r$.
nodes.title: Erdős layer criterion, power-of-four form

nodes.summary: For natural numbers $r$, $M$ and $N$ with $r \le M \le N$, we have $N^r \binom{M}{r} \le M^r \binom{N}{r}$.
nodes.title: Scaled monotonicity of binomial coefficients

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.
